title: Grant template tune
description: Turn the last week's parks and unused grants into template proposals.

suggestedChore.reason: Weekly, before you sign Monday's ledgers.

steps.name: analyse
steps.prompt: Use the control plane API at $API_URL (curl is fine; JSON responses). Useful routes: GET /projects, GET /projects/:id, GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id/events, GET /graph/:id, GET /workflows, GET /workflows/:id, GET /brief?hours=N, GET /audit?limit=N, GET /chores, GET /ledgers?status=signed, GET /proposals, POST /workflows, POST /projects, POST /projects/:id/continue, POST /chores, POST /tasks/:id/go. GET /audit?limit=1000 and GET /ledgers?status=signed. Per project and workflow: actions that parked 3+ times and were approved (candidates to add, with the tightest scope that would have covered them), grants with zero use over 5+ runs (candidates to remove), caps hit (candidates to raise with evidence). Write GRANTS.md with a table and the exact JSON edits per workflow.

steps.name: propose
steps.prompt: Use the control plane API at $API_URL (curl is fine; JSON responses). Useful routes: GET /projects, GET /projects/:id, GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id/events, GET /graph/:id, GET /workflows, GET /workflows/:id, GET /brief?hours=N, GET /audit?limit=N, GET /chores, GET /ledgers?status=signed, GET /proposals, POST /workflows, POST /projects, POST /projects/:id/continue, POST /chores, POST /tasks/:id/go. For each recommendation in GRANTS.md create a proposal node via POST /proposals is not available; instead POST /workflows with the updated grantTemplate ONLY for workflows where the change is a removal or a scope tightening. For additions, leave the recommendation in GRANTS.md for the operator to accept on the Workflow page. Print what you changed.
